plan.title: HF weights → tensor manifest → graph JSON pipeline
plan.objective: An offline Python pipeline that reads only the headers and small config files of every Hugging Face repo in the catalog, writes an Observed-only tensor manifest, and builds a verified viz-graph v1 JSON through a registered architecture library; plus the graph⇔TEL design with one round-trip proof.

requirements.text: `python -m tools.hf_graph <huggingface_url> [--revision R]` writes manifest.json, report.json and graph.json for one repo, and the batch runner calls this same function

Every row of `csv/categories/<category>/<format>.csv` becomes a job (huggingface_url → repo id), plus golden repos missing from the catalog from `csv/goldens.csv`; job count = 29,779 + golden extras (1 today)

Discovery records each repo's pinned `sha`, file list with sizes, `gated`, and the weight files to read per §5.1 (index shards, else root safetensors, diffusers component folders, one GGUF per D2 with multi-part as one file), or a terminal `skipped:*` status
Small files are fetched through `hf_hub_url(repo, path, revision=sha)` and cached by (repo, sha, path); a second run makes 0 network requests for cached rows
Safetensors headers of every shard are read by HTTP range (bytes 0-7, then 8..7+N) with 0 payload bytes; tensor count equals the index `weight_map`

GGUF headers (KV and tensor infos) are read by incremental HTTP range (1 MiB windows, doubling) within the D3 byte budget, large arrays stored as {type, count, head}, types from `gguf.constants`, never `GGUFReader`; tensor count equals `tensor_count`

`manifest.json` follows tensor-manifest v1 (§5.2) with a JSON Schema and a validator, holds Observed facts only, stores GGUF `ne` as read plus `shape` reversed and llama.cpp names as stored, and a re-run is byte-identical apart from `fetched_at`

Quantization sidecars (FP8 weight_scale_inv, MXFP4, GPTQ/AWQ, MLX, bitsandbytes, GGUF ggml types) bind only when their shape relation holds and each binding is recorded in report.json; Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 has every weight_scale_inv attached and 0 unbound sidecars

The ladder R1 (GGUF general.architecture), R2 (config architectures, then model_type, also nested in text_config/llm_config/language_config/thinker_config; diffusers `_class_name` from model_index.json and component configs; the timm `architecture`/`pretrained_cfg`; the catalog's backbone_class and timm_module), R3 (tensor-name fingerprint), R4 (name hint) proposes ranked candidates; Kimi-K2 resolves to the deepseek_v3 descriptor
Hyperparameters resolve from `metadata_spec.json` expressions, each recorded with its source (config key, GGUF key, shape, catalog, default); every dim in a graph has a recorded source in report.json
The binding verifier puts every stored tensor in exactly one class (bound, tied, ignored, aux, component) or fails the candidate with a near-miss report naming the tensor

The pipeline rebuilds each golden repo from its pinned header structurally equal to its `json/*.json` (same dims, parameter set and shapes, checkpoint_key or view per parameter, op/edge/multiplication counts and totals), each remaining difference listed with its cause

Path B traces timm and diffusers classes and descriptor-less LLM model_types on the `meta` device without remote code, maps ATen ops to Program primitives and the rest to typed `opaque` ops (D5); a tiny timm model and a tiny diffusers UNet give valid graphs whose parameters all bind

graph.json is viz-graph v1 plus only the §5.3 additive fields (checkpoint, provenance, components, execution), every parameter names a checkpoint_key or view, report.json is written, and graphs are stored once per content key with per-repo graph.ref (D9)
The batch runs over all rows with an append-only ledger.jsonl that drives resume, bounded concurrency and backoff, HF_TOKEN optional and never logged; killing and restarting skips completed rows
Coverage reports coverage.csv (category × format × status), coverage_model_type.csv (model_type × status) and near_misses.csv ranked by unlockable rows, with totals matching the ledger

docs/GRAPH_TEL.md records the §9 graph⇔TEL design (mapping, bindings, counted exclusions), and the per-graph round trip reproduces §9.5 on the 8 goldens: --const-as-buffer gives 0 differences and 6/8 pass D3; adding --fix-contract gives 8/8 with 0 differences, compile clean and D3 pass
The first task confirms every §2 input path; a missing or moved path is recorded in HARNESS.md, never assumed
Python work uses uv and the existing .venv (never conda); new dependencies go in optional extras only: `hub` (gguf, jsonschema) and `trace` (transformers, timm, diffusers)
`output/` and weight files (*.safetensors, *.gguf, *.bin, *.pt, *.pth, *.ckpt) are git-ignored and never stored; git holds small JSON test fixtures only

A viz-graph v1 JSON Schema written from the 8 goldens plus a checker enforce the §8.2 graph invariants (schema, acyclic, every op input produced earlier or an input/parameter, parameter shape equals header shape, totals recompute exactly); all 8 goldens pass
A structural comparator reports every difference between two graphs over the §8.1 fields (dims, parameter set and shapes, checkpoint_key or view, op/edge/multiplication counts, totals)
Besides header ranges, only config.json, *.safetensors.index.json, model_index.json, <component>/config.json, the timm config.json and params.json are ever fetched

Gated repos get skipped:gated without HF_TOKEN and skipped:gated_not_accepted when the token lacks accepted terms; the token never appears in logs, manifests or reports, and nothing about the user beyond it is sent
HTTP access uses bounded concurrency, exponential backoff on 429 and 5xx, and honours Retry-After
Header fixtures live in tests/fixtures/headers/<org>__<repo>@<sha>/ as small JSON only (config.json, index, per-file header JSON, provenance), never weights, and tests run offline from them
No repository code executes: trust_remote_code is never set, and remote-code repos bind only through a descriptor matched by `architectures`, else skipped:remote_code

Descriptors are JSON documents with match, hyperparameters (ordered sources plus a shape check), schemes (hf, gguf, mlx), recipe, ties, ignored and provenance, and support the layer selectors uniform, list(key), first_k(key), period, pattern, index_sets, per_layer_config and by_presence
The arch.mjs blocks rms, rope, softmax, gqa, swiglu and experts are ported to Python functions on Program, reusing program.py and viz.py rather than re-implementing them
The GPT-2 descriptor rebuilds json/distilgpt2.json byte-identically
Llama-family descriptors rebuild the qwen2.5-7b-instruct, mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3, phi-3.5-mini-instruct and gemma-2-2b-it goldens structurally equal from the configs they were spelled from

The mixtral and deepseek_v3 descriptors (arch.mjs ports) and the qwen3_5 descriptor (over qwen3_5.py) rebuild their goldens structurally equal from their spelled configs, deepseek's 174 keyless views matched rather than given invented keys
The same (repo, sha, registry version) produces byte-identical manifest.json, report.json and graph.json, `fetched_at` excluded

Each repo writes to output/categories/<category>/<format>/<org>__<repo>/ with a §5.4 status (ok, ok_assumed, partial, no_graph, skipped:*, failed:<code>); no_graph writes the tensor inventory and prefix tree
A 100-row smoke run measures throughput and header bytes per model before the full run is sized, and sets the D3 header byte budget
The §2 category/key table is recomputed from fetched data and the descriptor backlog is ordered by rows unlocked
Each golden repo is pinned at a sha in csv/goldens.csv and its real config.json is diffed against the config the golden was spelled from, every delta listed with its cause

HF↔GGUF name maps are generated from a pinned gguf-py (commit and MIT notice kept) plus an overlay of storage transforms (llama Q/K rope permutation checked at the pinned commit, fused QKV split, gate_up split, Gemma norm +1)

A conformance runner checks C1 (binding on a real header fixture), C3 (HF and GGUF schemes give the same canonical names), C4 (matmul, edge and FLOP counts), C5 (hostile input) and C6 (determinism) per descriptor
Descriptors for the top decoder_dense keys by rows pass C1, C4 and C6, and decoder_dense coverage rises by the predicted rows

Expert ops and their multiplications carry execution {kind: routed, of: E, active: K, router}, totals add contraction_flops and active_flops, active_flops equals the K-of-E hand count, and the mixtral and deepseek-v3 goldens stay structurally equal
All four expert storage forms bind and descriptors cover the top decoder_moe keys

Delta-rule and Mamba blocks are selected per layer (layer_types, hybrid_override_pattern), unrolled steps carry execution {kind: scan, axis: T, step, body}, the qwen3.8-27b-fp8 golden stays structurally equal, and descriptors cover the top decoder_hybrid keys

Assemblies bind the VLM text tower and mark vision towers, projectors, MTP and draft heads bound or declared_without_graph in `components`, never silently dropped; no stored tensor falls outside a class
BERT-family (bert, modernbert, xlm-roberta, roberta, deberta-v2, distilbert) and T5/BART (t5, mt5, bart, marian) descriptors pass C1 and C4
C2: for every path-A descriptor with an upstream class, the tiny-config path-A matmul signature equals path B's, modulo dense-vs-routed experts
After the full run every job has one terminal status, the reports add up to the R-01 job count, and a re-run with unchanged shas is a no-op
Each output/categories/<category>/README.md summarizes that category's statuses, keys and near-misses
tel_roundtrip runs over every graph the pipeline writes
A TEL coverage analyzer counts per graph the T♭-spellable ops and each §9.4 counted exclusion
`tools/viz_to_tel.py` → `tools/tel_compile.mjs` on distilgpt2 still prints PASS
The T♭ printer and decoder are ported to Python next to viz_graph() with both §9.6 fixes, matching tel.js on the 8 goldens (T-2 default)
Pipeline graphs keep `axes[].symbol` for B and T

waves.focus: Foundations (master Wave 0): catalog, fetch, headers, manifest, registry core, path-A ports of the 8 goldens, single-URL CLI, batch with a 100-row smoke run; the TEL proof (master Wave T) runs alongside
waves.gate: tests/test_goldens.py: 8 goldens structurally equal from pinned headers (gemma-2 skipped when its gated fixture is absent); D3 set from the 100-row smoke run; tel_roundtrip reproduces §9.5
waves.concurrency: sequential; 09a has no dependencies and can run at any point in the wave

waves.focus: Dense decoders (master Wave 1): generated name maps, sidecars, conformance runner, top dense descriptors; TEL Python port
waves.gate: tools.conformance passes C1/C4/C6 for every dense descriptor; Qwen3.8 FP8 has 0 unbound sidecars; decoder_dense coverage rises by the predicted rows

waves.focus: MoE (master Wave 2): routed annotations, active_flops, four expert storage forms, MoE descriptors
waves.gate: mixtral and deepseek-v3 goldens structurally equal and active_flops equals the K-of-E hand count

waves.focus: Hybrid and state (master Wave 3): delta rule, Mamba, layer selectors, scan annotation
waves.gate: qwen3.8-27b-fp8 golden structurally equal with scan annotations on every unrolled step

waves.focus: Assemblies (master Wave 4): VLM wrappers, MTP, draft heads
waves.gate: no stored tensor outside a class on the multimodal_vlm and speculative_draft rows run
C1 and C4 pass for every encoder descriptor

waves.focus: Library trace (master Wave 6): path B for timm, diffusers and uncovered LLM keys; C2
waves.gate: tiny timm and UNet graphs bind fully; C2 passes for every path-A descriptor with an upstream class

waves.focus: Full run (master Wave 7) and TEL round trip over all pipeline graphs
waves.gate: every job has a terminal status and the reports add up to the R-01 job count

tasks.text: Write 07e DESIGN.md: new blocks (layer-norm post-norm, bidirectional attention, GELU FFN, T5 relative position bias, cross attention), the keys (bert, modernbert, xlm-roberta, roberta, deberta-v2, distilbert, t5, mt5, bart, marian) and each one's C4 hand count (no goldens exist)
tasks.verify: DESIGN.md lists each key with its blocks and the hand-counted matmuls and FLOPs used for C4

tasks.text: [network for fixtures] Add the BERT-family descriptors
tasks.verify: `.venv/bin/python -m tools.conformance bert modernbert xlm-roberta roberta deberta-v2 distilbert` prints C1 and C4 PASS

tasks.text: [network for fixtures] Add the T5/BART descriptors with cross attention
tasks.verify: `.venv/bin/python -m tools.conformance t5 mt5 bart marian` prints C1 and C4 PASS

tasks.text: [network] Run encoder and encoder_decoder rows and `--coverage`
tasks.verify: every encoder descriptor passes C1 and C4 and encoder ok rows rise by the DESIGN.md prediction minus listed misses

acceptance.text: C1 and C4 pass for every encoder descriptor

modules.title: Path B library trace and the C2 signature check
modules.goal: Trace transformers/timm/diffusers classes on the meta device into Program primitives as the coverage fallback, and check path A against path B (C2).

tasks.text: Write 06f DESIGN.md: building a library class from config.json on the `meta` device (never trust_remote_code), torch.export vs torch.fx, the ATen → Program mapping taken from OPS/generated/pytorch-tel-mapping.md, typed opaque ops (D5), parameter-name binding through bind.py, certainty 'traced'
tasks.verify: DESIGN.md has the ATen mapping table for the ops a tiny resnet and a tiny UNet2DConditionModel produce

tasks.text: Install the trace extra (`uv sync --inexact --extra trace --extra hub --extra dev`)
tasks.verify: `.venv/bin/python -c 'import timm, diffusers, transformers'` exits 0

tasks.text: Write src/gpt2_pytorch/registry/trace.py: class from config on meta, export, map ATen ops to Program primitives, the rest to opaque ops with typed ports, then viz_graph()
tasks.verify: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_trace.py -q` passes: a tiny timm resnet and a tiny diffusers UNet give graphs that pass tools.graph_check with every parameter bound

tasks.text: Make run_one fall back to path B when no path-A candidate binds (provenance path B)
tasks.verify: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_pipeline.py -q -k path_b` passes on a timm fixture

tasks.text: Add `--c2` to tools/conformance.py: for each path-A descriptor with an upstream class, compare tiny-config matmul signatures of path A and path B modulo dense-vs-routed experts
tasks.verify: `.venv/bin/python -m tools.conformance --c2 all` prints PASS for every descriptor with an upstream class

tasks.text: [network] Run vision_* and diffusion_* rows plus uncovered LLM keys and `--coverage`
tasks.verify: coverage.csv shows path-B ok rows in those categories and ledger has no row that ran repo code (no trust_remote_code anywhere: `rg -n trust_remote_code src tools` finds only False/absent)

acceptance.text: Tiny timm and UNet graphs are valid and bind fully
C2 passes for every path-A descriptor with an upstream class

blockers.blocker: Data-dependent MoE traces specialize or fail
blockers.response: MoE stays on path A; path B reports failed:trace_<code> and C2 compares modulo routed experts

modules.title: Full catalog run, category READMEs, TEL round trip over all graphs
modules.goal: Run every job to a terminal status, prove the reports add up and the re-run is a no-op, write category READMEs and round-trip every stored graph through TEL.

tasks.text: [network] Run `python -m tools.hf_graph --all` at the D3-sized concurrency, then `--coverage`
tasks.verify: ledger.jsonl has exactly one terminal status per load_jobs() job and coverage.csv sums to that count

tasks.text: Add `--readme` to tools/hf_graph.py writing output/categories/<category>/README.md (status counts, top keys, top near-misses)
tasks.verify: one README.md per category directory, and each one's totals equal that category's coverage.csv rows

tasks.text: Run tools/tel_roundtrip.cjs and tools.tel_coverage over output/categories/graphs/
tasks.verify: `node tools/tel_roundtrip.cjs output/categories/graphs --const-as-buffer --fix-contract` prints one line per stored graph plus a summary

tasks.text: [network] Re-run `--all` with unchanged shas
tasks.verify: the second run appends 0 terminal ledger rows and reads 0 header bytes

acceptance.text: Every job is terminal, reports add up, and the re-run is a no-op
Each category has a README whose totals match coverage
Every stored graph goes through the TEL round trip
